simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גִּבֵּחַ (H1371) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: גִּבֵּחַ (gibbêach) means bald in the forehead First listed occurrence: Lev 13 41.

definitions.full: H1371. gibbeach גִּבֵּחַ adjective having a bald forehead , ׳ג הוּא Lev 13:41 (P || הוּא קֵרֵחַ 13:40 ).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to be high (in the forehead);
